evidence: Use model-derived virtual output and RAM-transform groups to measure ambiguity of simple output-control predicates; none is an observed hardware label.
limitations: Training labels are proposed roles, not physical I/O observations. RAM writes do not inherently exclude simultaneous external writes.
Held-out table groups share instruction templates with training groups; their agreement is not independent hardware evidence.
Predicates are conjunctions of up to two raw bits, with arbitrary polarity. No predicate is installed as an output strobe.
All used-word activations are reported, including branches, calls and RAM-writing instructions; unknown cases are not treated as false positives.
